about: The hare grazing (HUNTING 2, GRAZE): crouched, the head down and the nose on the ground, the forequarters and the head turned to one side and the ears laid back apart (so the down view reads as a head beside the body), nibbling: down, up a little, down a little further round, up. Four poses of the body's own Graze, played by time; the head-up beat of GRAZE is the alert or the idle.
